- Iteratively extended and restarted across 6+ independent anchors (32, 33, 18, 16, 19, 38). Each time a weak/negative marginal gain triggered my declared restart rule, which I honored rather than ignoring.
- The combination **[feature 33 long, feature 35 short]** repeatedly emerged as the best 2-feature rule across multiple independent search paths, at Sharpe 0.491 (all-years-equal) / 0.554 (recent-weighted) — well above every other anchor tried and far above the baseline model.
